info.text:
No Social Security credits? Medicare Part A can cost $565 a month.
Without 40 work credits (max 4 a year), your own retirement check is $0. One credit takes $1,890 of taxed pay in 2026.
The fallback, SSI, is capped at $994 a month in 2026, for people 65-plus, blind or disabled with very little income.
With under 30 credits, Medicare Part A costs $565 a month in 2026. That's $6,780 a year.
Sources: SSA, CMS.
News and education, not financial advice.
